# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P2](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** rose-red girl  <sub>[v1 c35 P2](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel possesses dark eyes and a striking, vibrant, and rosy-red appearance. She won the beauty prize among the Second Year classes at Regent's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P2](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0002), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Mabel has a heart brimming with yearnings, dreams, and imaginations that are as light and multicolored as Nell's.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P2](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0002)_

## Traits

- imaginative  <sub>[v1 c35 P2](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0002)</sub>

## History

Mabel attended Regent's Academy in Port Marlow alongside Nell Harcourt and formed a close circle of friends with Nell and Honora Hollis. During her time at the Academy, she won the beauty prize for the Second Year classes.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P2](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0002), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Relationships

- Friend of — close friend at Regent's Academy  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c36 P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021)</sub>

### Honora Hollis

- Friend of — part of a small group of friends at Regent's Academy  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
